chunks: From him, from al-Barqī, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: What is permitted to a man from a menstruating woman? He said: “What is between her buttocks, but he must not penetrate.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man or husband asking about what is permitted
key_terms.مَا بَيْنَ أَلْيَتَيْهَا: the area between her buttocks, mentioned here in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is permitted between a man and his menstruating wife according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intimacy with a menstruating woman. It indicates that forms of intimacy are permitted, while prohibiting sexual penetration.
